steps: Be a U.S. citizen and registered Nevada voter (students 16+ need parent/guardian and school permission).
Apply for a vote-center position at washoecounty.gov/voters/work.
Complete the required training ($35 pay) and pass the hands-on evaluation.
Work Election Day (approximately 14+ hours) at an assigned vote center; optional Election Eve setup earns $25.
timing: Election-day only; approximately 14+ hours on Election Day per the county, plus required training and optional Election Eve setup.
